visual_review.method: Codex visual inspection of all eight scene frames in both aspect ratios, plus full-resolution caption, acceptance, check-output, board and post-completion frames
visual_review.findings: Readable captions; real application states; all three task titles visible; current checks and completion controls shown; closing URL correct; no personal paths, credentials, empty application windows or persistent spinners observed
visual_review.limitations: Representative-frame review, not a claim of exhaustive OCR or a security guarantee. Synthetic mock inference, no live-provider quality benchmark.
